interactiveSecurity.title: Where product data moves
interactiveSecurity.description: Select a connection to inspect the proposed data, timing and control. Every connection still needs Alvi’s confirmation before this diagram can be published.

import.label: Import catalog
import.what: Product fields from the selected store or feed. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
import.when: During catalog import or sync. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
import.control: Uses the store connection permissions or the source you choose. Importing does not publish listing changes. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}

request.label: Send to AI
request.what: Selected product and competitor details for comparisons or listing generation. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
request.when: When a simulation or listing-generation action runs. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
request.control: Uses the configured provider route. Connected Merchant Center account data remains separate from the store catalog used for AI work. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}

response.label: Return results
response.what: Simulation results or generated listing and structured-data content. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
response.when: When the requested model operation returns. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
response.control: Apply can generate and publish within the same action; structured data uses its separate publish action. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}

apply.label: Apply listing
apply.what: A generated title and description for selected products. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
apply.when: When you choose Apply or an explicit bulk publishing action. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
apply.control: Requires a directly connected store and your explicit publishing action. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}

structuredData.label: Publish data
structuredData.what: Generated Product JSON-LD in the store’s product metadata. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
structuredData.when: On the separate Publish structured data action. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
structuredData.control: The Shopify theme app embed or WooCommerce plugin must render the published data. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}

merchantCenter.label: Sync Google
merchantCenter.what: Published title and description overrides plus selected checkout attributes. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
merchantCenter.when: On a separate explicit Google sync for a connected Shopify store. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
merchantCenter.control: Uses a supplemental source alongside the main feed. Applying a listing does not automatically run this sync. {{TODO: Alvi confirms}}
